content.audience: Synthetic benchmark operator measuring the studio's build path at small scale
content.problem_statement: Measure whether the bounded builder and independent reviewer can deliver a single-module Python standard-library CLI that counts words read from stdin, against frozen exact-output cases including held-out edge cases. This is a synthetic benchmark, not a customer product.

user_flows.name: Default tally
steps: Pipe text into the CLI with no arguments
Read the three most frequent words with their counts

user_flows.name: Choose how many
steps: Read at most K words with their counts

user_flows.name: No words
steps: Pipe text that has no letters or digits

user_flows.name: Invalid arguments
steps: Run with an argument the CLI does not accept
Read the invalid input message and exit status 2

scope: Python 3.8+ standard library only, entry point src/main.py, all code under src
Read all of stdin as text. A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters A-Z, a-z and digits 0-9; every other character separates words. Words are lowercased before counting

Print one line per word as the word, one space, the count, newline. Order by count descending, then word ascending (plain string order). Print at most K lines; fewer when there are fewer distinct words
K is 3 by default. --top K sets it, where K is one or more ASCII digits with value 1 to 50. --top may appear at most once
When stdin has no words print exactly: no words, then newline, and exit 0
Any other argument, a missing or invalid K, or a repeated --top prints exactly: invalid input, then newline, and exits 2. Nothing else is printed
Exit 0 on success. No files, network, environment variables or third-party packages

data_contracts.name: wordtally/1
data_contracts.description: Synthetic text on stdin; plain text lines on stdout

acceptance_checks.statement: With no arguments print the three most frequent lowercased words, ties by word

cases.stdin: the cat and the hat and the bat

Apple apple APPLE banana
banana cherry 42 42 42 42

acceptance_checks.statement: --top K prints at most K words
Input without words prints no words
Invalid arguments print invalid input and exit 2

risks.risk: One benchmark at small scale does not establish general build quality
risks.mitigation: Report it only as small-scale evidence for this recipe, route, model and role prompts

risks.risk: Held-out cases leak to the builder
risks.mitigation: The studio hides held-out cases from builder and reviewer; the repository copy is never sent to runtime roles

obligations: Keep this frozen version unchanged; changes need a new benchmark version
maintenance.review_interval: On recipe, role prompt, route or model change

tasks.title: Implement the word tally CLI
tasks.deliverable: src/main.py that passes every acceptance check
